name: Picmal
soft_passes: #1 mask: artwork fills the squircle cleanly but a ~1px saturated-blue keyline is baked onto the mask edge (system should own the stroke)
#4 16px: survives only as a blue+white colour blob; ribbon detail smears, identity is colour not form
#7 figure-ground: blue-vs-pale holds (~5.4:1) but pale-periwinkle vs near-white ribbons collapse in grayscale (~1.2:1)
#9 era: internally consistent flat-custom but declines the Tahoe/Liquid Glass material vocabulary — reads as a web-graphic tile
failures: #3 silhouette: filled solid black it is a bare squircle — no nameable subject; abstract field by choice but nothing says media/convert
#10 variant robustness: opaque fixed blue+white field, not a layered Icon Composer design — no dark/clear/tinted adaptation; near-white ribbons would glare in dark mode

palette.background: flat #1B5BFF field (corners) with #CBDEFF + #F2F6FF flowing ribbon bands

light_model: flat/ambient — opaque flat fills, no directional light, no baked micro-shadows, no specular; commits to no era light model
layer_stack: saturated-blue hairline keyline ~#0078FF on mask edge
devices: marbled flow field (full-bleed fluid S-curve ribbons, no glyph)
baked saturated-blue keyline on the squircle
rhymes_hint: abstract fluid/marble-field utility icons — single-hue tonal tiles and flow motifs rather than glyph-on-gradient; kin to wallpaper-style abstract icons and the 'brand-blob' school
notes: 256x256 resized web render, not the 1024 master — all hex (estimated), fine ribbon/specular/keyline-width unverifiable at this size. Strong palette discipline (one hue, three stops) and strong icon<->app brand coherence: electric #1B5BFF is the app accent throughout the cover (Convert button, corner wedges, list checkboxes, footer wordmark). Weakness is legibility of purpose: no glyph/subject, so the icon communicates brand-colour not function — distinct in colour, anonymous as a media converter. Not a native layered/glass icon; flat opaque construction. #3 is a non-negotiable check (would not clear the generation bar despite 10/12).
